data.name: Rinkbound:Curling
data.detailed_description:
Rinkbound: Curling is a competitive curling game built around high-fidelity realistic rendering, simulation-driven physics, and authentic shot control. Each delivery, rotation, collision, and shot placement can shape the outcome, creating a curling experience focused on precision, strategy, and realistic ice and stone behavior.

The initial Early Access release includes the following core content:

  • Match Lobby: Online 1v1

  • Match with Friends: Online 1v1

  • Training Mode

Match Lobby supports online 1v1 matches by allowing players to view online players, send match invitations, and create or join match rooms. Match with Friends allows players to play online 1v1 matches directly with friends. Training Mode provides an editable practice environment where players can set up stone positions, recreate situations, and repeatedly practice different lines, shot weights, rotations, and shot solutions.

Content currently in development includes:

  • Challenge Mode

  • Tactical Mode

During Early Access, our main development priority is:

  • Challenge Mode

We will continue refining the current gameplay experience throughout Early Access and gradually expand the game based on player feedback.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
